subject: English
question_text: Read the following sentences and put them in correct order.
stimulus: (a) They can only reflect the sun light. (b) Planets are not stars. (c) Their number is nine. (d) It is often called the ‘Evening slar’. (e) Venus is one of them. (f) It has a light. (g) It is a beautiful planet. (h) They have no light of their own.
guide_solution: b → h → a → c → e → g → f → d
